delay_description: Moving abroad / leaving residence — must physically move out

trigger_phrases.phrase: Relocating abroad with a firm departure date already set
Relocating and needs a remote/hands-off management solution while away
Considering relocating to another city — decision window still open
Must sell/complete on another property before they can vacate this one
Relocating for work — awaiting employer's confirmed start/move date
Extended annual travel sets the earliest realistic launch window

typical_timeline.notes: Departure timing ranged from same-day confirmation (awaiting an employer call that afternoon) to an eight-month annual travel cycle; most concrete departure dates clustered around two to three months out from the call.

what_leads_focus_on_while_waiting.concern: Whether remote/hands-off management actually works when they're not in the country
Getting a firm departure date confirmed (from an employer, a sale, or their own plans) before committing to a go-live date
Coordinating the exact onboarding/go-live date around the move-out window
A prerequisite sale of another property needed to fund or enable the move
Partner/family sign-off on the plan before proceeding

how_to_handle_in_meeting.acknowledge_phrase: That makes complete sense — let me know what's covered on that call and we can work out a timeline; it's nice to have a few weeks' notice ahead of time so onboarding is smoother.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.timeline_question: Once you've got your move/departure date confirmed, roughly how much notice would you want to give us to get everything onboarded and live before you go?
how_to_handle_in_meeting.reframe_approach: Treat the departure date as the trigger for a pre-planned onboarding window, not as a reason to pause the conversation — agree now what happens in the weeks immediately after they leave.
how_to_handle_in_meeting.how_to_keep_engaged: Ask for a specific update point tied to their own confirmation event (employer call, sale completion, visa date) and reassure them concretely that remote ownership is normal (cite managing for owners already abroad).
how_to_handle_in_meeting.what_to_write_to_monday: Log the expected departure/vacate date, what it's contingent on (employer confirmation, a sale, visa), and the notice period the lead wants before going live, so the follow-up is timed to their real trigger event.

conversion_after_delay.drop_off_reason: Likely deterred by large 5-bed setup costs and timing uncertainty; moved abroad

do_not_attempt_offer_because: The lead is not yet physically out of the property (or not yet certain when they will be), so there is no date Stayful can realistically go live by — a signing deadline set before their actual move-out date only pressures a decision the lead cannot yet act on.
